name: Gunjan Kumari
department: School of Liberal Arts and Sciences
bio: Her research focuses on Applied Microeconomics, Development Economics, and International Economics. She has published her research in internationally peer-reviewed journals, including the European Journal of Health Economics and Energy Policy. She has teaching experience at the University of Delhi and presented her research work at leading national and international conferences in India and Abroad.
teaching: Foundations of Gender Studies: Gender and Economics
